```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
set.seed(42)
```

## 1. Load Libraries
```{r libraries}
library(SpatialExperiment)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(scuttle)
library(dittoSeq)
library(viridis)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)
```

## 2. Defining Paths
```{r paths}
analysis_path <- "/restricted/projectnb/camplab/projects/20220504_Suzuki_LN/TumorIMC/analysis"
spe_path <- file.path(analysis_path, "final_cell_annotation", "h5_cluster_annot.rds")

out_path <- file.path(analysis_path, "final_cell_annotation", "marker_heatmap")
dir.create(out_path, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

## 3. Loading in Intensities (Asinh Normal + w/o)
```{r load}
spe <- readRDS(spe_path)
cluster_col <- "broad_clusters"

# add exprs assay (asinh-normalized) alongside existing counts assay
assay(spe, "exprs") <- asinh(assay(spe, "counts") / 1)

# all 41 channels are rownames, but 3 are technical (not real markers) - exclude them
technical_channels <- c("DNA191", "DNA193", "Membrane")
use_channels <- setdiff(rownames(spe), technical_channels)

# assay types to run: raw counts and asinh-normalized
assay_types <- c(counts = "Intensities", exprs = "Asinh Intensities")
```

## 4. Mean Expression Heatmaps
```{r mean-heatmap,fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
for (a in names(assay_types)) {
  cluster_mean <- aggregateAcrossCells(as(spe, "SingleCellExperiment"),
                                        ids = colData(spe)[[cluster_col]],
                                        statistics = "mean",
                                        use.assay.type = a,
                                        subset_row = use_channels)

  mat <- assay(cluster_mean, a)
  cluster_ids <- colData(cluster_mean)[[cluster_col]]
  ncells_vec <- colData(cluster_mean)$ncells

  cluster_colors <- setNames(dittoColors()[seq_along(sort(unique(cluster_ids)))],
                              sort(unique(cluster_ids)))

  col_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    ncells = ncells_vec,
    broad_clusters = factor(cluster_ids),
    col = list(
      ncells = colorRamp2(range(ncells_vec), c("white", "#c9184a")),
      broad_clusters = cluster_colors
    ),
    annotation_name_side = "left"
  )

  ht <- Heatmap(mat,
                name = paste0("Mean ", assay_types[[a]]),
                col = colorRamp2(seq(min(mat), max(mat), length.out = 100), viridis(100)),
                top_annotation = col_anno,
                column_title = paste0("Mean Marker Expression per Cluster\n", assay_types[[a]]),
                cluster_rows = TRUE,
                cluster_columns = TRUE,
                show_column_names = FALSE,
                row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8))

  png(file.path(out_path, paste0("mean_heatmap_", a, ".png")),
      width = 3800, height = 2800, res = 300)
  draw(ht, merge_legend = TRUE)
  dev.off()

  # print again so it displays inline when knit
  draw(ht, merge_legend = TRUE)
}
```

## 5. SD Heatmaps
```{r sd-heatmap,fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
sd_df_list <- list()

for (a in names(assay_types)) {
  mat <- assay(spe, a)[use_channels, ]
  cluster_ids <- colData(spe)[[cluster_col]]

  sd_df <- as.data.frame(t(mat)) %>%
    mutate(cluster = cluster_ids) %>%
    pivot_longer(-cluster, names_to = "marker", values_to = "value") %>%
    group_by(cluster, marker) %>%
    summarise(sd = sd(value), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = cluster, values_from = sd)

  sd_df_list[[a]] <- sd_df

  sd_mat <- as.matrix(sd_df[, -1])
  rownames(sd_mat) <- sd_df$marker

  sd_mat_z <- t(scale(t(sd_mat)))

  ht <- Heatmap(sd_mat_z,
                name = paste0("Z-scored SD\n(", assay_types[[a]], ")"),
                col = colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("#440154", "white", "#fde725")),
                column_title = paste0("Relative SD of Marker Expression per Cluster\n", assay_types[[a]]),
                cluster_rows = TRUE,
                cluster_columns = TRUE,
                row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8))

  png(file.path(out_path, paste0("sd_heatmap_", a, ".png")),
      width = 3800, height = 2900, res = 300)
  draw(ht)
  grid.text(paste0(cluster_col, " (cluster ID)"),
            x = unit(0.5, "npc"), y = unit(0.015, "npc"),
            gp = gpar(fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold"))
  dev.off()

  # print again so it displays inline when knit
  draw(ht)
  grid.text(paste0(cluster_col, " (cluster ID)"),
            x = unit(0.5, "npc"), y = unit(0.015, "npc"),
            gp = gpar(fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold"))
}
```

## 6. Boxplots of High/Low Markers within Each Cluster (Asinh Only)
```{r extreme-marker-boxplots, fig.width=12, fig.height=14}
n_extreme <- 10 # number of high + low markers to show per cluster

exprs_mat <- assay(spe, "exprs")[use_channels, ]
cluster_ids <- as.character(colData(spe)[[cluster_col]])

long_df <- as.data.frame(t(exprs_mat)) %>%
  mutate(cluster = cluster_ids) %>%
  pivot_longer(-cluster, names_to = "marker", values_to = "value")

# per-cluster marker means, used only to pick which markers are "high" or "low"
cluster_means <- long_df %>%
  group_by(cluster, marker) %>%
  summarise(mean_val = mean(value), .groups = "drop")

# for each cluster, keep the top n_extreme highest and n_extreme lowest markers
extreme_markers <- cluster_means %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(mean_val, n = n_extreme) %>%
  mutate(direction = "High") %>%
  bind_rows(
    cluster_means %>%
      group_by(cluster) %>%
      slice_min(mean_val, n = n_extreme) %>%
      mutate(direction = "Low")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(cluster, marker, direction)

# subset the full per-cell data down to only these marker/cluster combos
plot_df <- long_df %>%
  inner_join(extreme_markers, by = c("cluster", "marker")) %>%
  mutate(cluster = factor(cluster, levels = as.character(sort(as.numeric(unique(cluster))))))

p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = reorder(marker, value, FUN = median), y = value, fill = direction)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~cluster, scales = "free", ncol = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(High = "#fde725", Low = "#440154")) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Highest and Lowest Expressed Markers within Each Cluster",
       subtitle = paste0("Asinh Intensities - top/bottom ", n_extreme, " markers by mean, per cluster"),
       x = "Marker", y = "Asinh Intensity", fill = "Direction") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7))

png(file.path(out_path, "extreme_markers_boxplots_by_cluster_exprs.png"),
    width = 4800, height = 5600, res = 300)
print(p)
dev.off()

# print again so it displays inline when knit
print(p)
```
